mathematical_rule: For two rows with nonzero leading coefficients, the two updated rows are scalar multiples. Shared cancellation features cancel in the source score; bypass evaluation only when the remaining sparse score guarantees the native source. Unsupported coefficients also use the native source.
adoption_rule: Separate confirmation only if model forward-stage geometric mean ratio is below 0.98 and complete-time ratio is at most 1.01. Models and seed thresholds remain fixed.
